Output format

A quiz is downloadable only when its source MCQ count can be checked. Unverifiable scans show a file error instead of an incomplete PDF.

Scanned pages without readable text remain in the source appendix. No text or explanations are invented.

Original-layout mode keeps printed questions and answers. It does not create a new quiz or red/green answer feedback.

Text size applies to reflowed documents. Original PDFs and images keep their layout.

Your browser may ask you to allow multiple downloads. You can also download all results as one ZIP.

04 Local CBT practice

Unofficial practice

Convert question files above, then take a timed paper from the MCQs extracted on this device. One question appears at a time. Answers and explanations appear after submission. This browser-only practice does not have server-enforced exam security.

Fresh question pages

Quiz mode creates clean pages without printed answer marks. Every option opens the next answer page. Correct is green; incorrect choices are red. Long explanations continue on the following page.

Unknown answers

Questions without a reliable key remain in the quiz and show “No answer for this question.” Nothing needs manual review to export.

Compatible PDF feedback

Ordinary PDF links open one answer page per question in common readers. The answer and every available option discussion appear once, in sequence.

Supported formats & conversion details

Each source file produces its own downloadable quiz PDF. The separate combine tool accepts quiz PDFs created by this version and rebuilds them with continuous question numbers. Old quizzes with five repeated answer pages per question are rebuilt with one answer page. Modern quizzes keep their existing pages. Upload the existing quiz and new question files together; a second existing quiz cannot be used as a base in the same batch. Files with no recognized MCQs are skipped. Files with an unverifiable or mismatched source count are blocked. It supports text-based PDF question banks with BMJ OnExamination layout, structured questions with A–E choices, and image-based question banks with five shaded option rows. Scanned pages are read with English OCR on your device; large batches can take a long time. The status shows pages processed and MCQs found. OCR may misread poor scans; some embedded clinical images may not carry into rebuilt quiz pages. Unknown answer keys are labeled, never guessed. Original-layout mode preserves source PDF pages and their printed answers while adding navigation and forms; its choice markers do not show correct/wrong feedback. Digital signatures do not survive modification. Password-protected PDFs are rejected. DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and images remain available in original-layout mode.
